required_tools.name: gkos_capabilities
required_tools.title: List effective GKOS capabilities
required_tools.description: Lists only effective capabilities for the authenticated session; it issues no references and reveals no paths, hidden adapters, or identity records.

required_tools.name: gkos_record_validate
required_tools.title: Validate one discovered GKX record
required_tools.description: Resolves an authority-issued record reference, physically qualifies the path, reads bounded source bytes, and returns closed diagnostic codes from the Full parser.

required_tools.name: gkos_record_assess
required_tools.title: Assess one discovered GKX record
required_tools.description: Runs the deterministic Full projection and assessment on an already discovered, policy-visible record; the assessment is not truth or governance authority.

required_tools.name: gkos_lineage_get
required_tools.title: Read discovered record lineage
required_tools.description: Projects the Full graph lineage for one discovered record and returns policy-filtered summaries through a bounded stateful snapshot cursor.

required_tools.name: gkos_graph_at_time
required_tools.title: Project the discovered graph at a time
required_tools.description: Requires a live same-session scope_ref issued by navigation discovery, resolves and physically requalifies that scope, then applies the Full temporal projector and returns bounded authorized record summaries; it never performs a fresh unscoped graph scan.

required_tools.name: gkos_navigation_discover
required_tools.title: Discover qualified Navigation entries
required_tools.description: With scope_ref:null and cursor:null, performs policy and physical-root qualification and issues the authorized root scope_ref plus bounded policy-visible record_ref and child scope_ref values; later calls/pages reuse only a same-session issued scope_ref.

required_tools.name: gkos_navigation_audit
required_tools.title: Audit a qualified Navigation scope
required_tools.description: Runs the qualified Full Navigation audit after discovery and physical qualification, returning closed finding codes without filesystem-oracle detail.

deferred_tools.name: gkos_record_get

deferred_tools.name: gkos_record_search

deferred_tools.name: gkos_policy_get

deferred_tools.name: gkos_navigation_context
deferred_tools.reconsideration_gate: Freeze atomic bounded artifact bytes, omission codes, and policy-visible source accounting.

deferred_tools.name: gkos_navigation_diff
deferred_tools.reconsideration_gate: Freeze immutable qualified Navigation snapshot artifacts and exact diff result schemas.

deferred_tools.name: gkos_reentry_plan

deferred_tools.name: gkos_navigation_effect_plan
